{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: check
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  reapack-index:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Fetch repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Pandoc
      run:  sudo apt-get install -yy pandoc
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: 3.2
        cache: true
    - name: Install reapack-index
      run:  gem install reapack-index --pre
    - name: Validate packages
      run:  reapack-index --check",
  "rationale": "Add RubyGems dependency caching via ruby/setup-ruby's cache option. The workflow repeatedly installs the reapack-index gem on every run; caching the RubyGems directory avoids re-downloading and re-installing unchanged gems while preserving all existing steps and the validate-packages check. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads), which reports measurable VM-time savings for repeated dependency fetching, with no contraindications present (no mutable/untrusted cached content, no existing equivalent cache).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
